info.name: blitzyxsc — X/Twitter Free API
info.description:
blitzyxsc — Auth-free X/Twitter scraping API by Blitz (blitzlabx).

Multi-provider router: composable → syndication → nitter → twscrape → snscrape → rss.
No auth, no rate limits, no account ban risk.

Set the `base_url` variable to your blitzyxsc deployment URL.

variable.description: Base URL of your blitzyxsc deployment. Replace with your actual URL (e.g. https://blitzyxsc.vercel.app, http://localhost:8000, etc.).
